enrichment.headline: Approves up to $5.59M for Effective School Solutions mental health staff at three schools through 2026
enrichment.summary: Effective School Solutions will place a full-time mental health therapist and a full-time mental health aide, three of each, to provide required services to students with Individualized Education Programs (IEPs) in special day classes at Montera and Roosevelt Middle Schools and McClymonds High School, plus other support staff. The term is July 16, 2023 through June 30, 2026.

enrichment.summary: Attitudinal Healing Connection will provide a visual arts instructor to work with the school's Algebra teacher on arts integration and a cultural arts instructor to lead a morning drumming circle at McClymonds High School. The period is June 5, 2023 through July 7, 2023.

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.headline: Student behavioral health partnership with Alameda Alliance for Health pays the district up to $1.69M
enrichment.summary: This memorandum of understanding (MOU) has the district carry out four interventions under the Student Behavioral Health Incentive Program, a state Medi-Cal program run locally by Alameda Alliance for Health: expanding wellness programs, expanding the behavioral health workforce, reaching targeted populations, and building partnerships to improve access to Medi-Cal services. The Alliance pays the district, up to $1,686,880.73, in installments tied to completed milestones and state approval; funds must be returned if milestones are not met. The period is January 1, 2023 through June 30, 2025.

items.fundingSource: Alameda Alliance for Health via California’s Child and Youth Behavioral Health Initiative

outcome.action: Adopted on the General Consent Report

enrichment.summary: The California Department of Social Services is adding $550,000 for 2022-2023 to this grant, raising the agreement's not-to-exceed amount from $1,835,520 to $2,385,520. The amendment also extends the agreement to June 30, 2026, and all other terms stay the same.

enrichment.summary: This amendment adds $200,000 to the district's agreement with the law firm Fagen Friedman & Fulfrost LLP, bringing the total not to exceed $700,000 for the 2022-23 fiscal year. The firm provides hourly legal services defending claims and lawsuits, including some about facilities and special education, plus general advice requested by the Legal Department. The original agreement is a memorandum of understanding (MOU) and engagement policy.

outcome.action: Adopted
